subject: general
question: Who among the following launched the digital platform ‘FASTER’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chief Justice of India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The digital platform **FASTER** was launched by the **Chief Justice of India**.
 
• FASTER stands for **Fast and Secure Transmission of Electronic Records**.
 
• This platform aims to ensure swift and secure transmission of court orders and other judicial documents.
 
• It enhances the efficiency of the judicial system by reducing delays in communication and implementation of court orders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Supreme Court of India** is the highest judicial forum and final court of appeal under the Constitution of India.
 
• The Chief Justice of India is the head of the judiciary of India and the Supreme Court.
 
• The **Supreme Court** consists of the Chief Justice and a maximum of 33 other judges, appointed by the President of India.
 
• The judiciary plays a crucial role in the interpretation and protection of the Constitution and the rights of individuals.
 
• Technological advancements like the FASTER platform are part of ongoing efforts to modernize the judicial system and improve access to justice.
